Vendored third-party sources

Only files the F3 build opens are kept. License texts: vendor/CMSIS_5/LICENSE.txt,
vendor/ST_LICENSE.txt, vendor/CMSIS_std/LICENSE.txt.

vendor/CMSIS_5/
  Source:  https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5 (tag 5.9.0)
  License: Apache-2.0
  Files are byte-identical to that tag.

vendor/STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver/ (library V1.2.3)
  Source:  STM32F30x DSP and standard peripherals library (STSW-STM32108)
           https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-stm32108.html
  License: ST Proprietary (Software Package License Agreement SLA0048, see
           vendor/ST_LICENSE.txt). File headers name "MCD-ST Liberty SW
           License Agreement V2".
  Local changes: src/stm32f30x_rcc.c and src/stm32f30x_hrtim.c add
  __attribute__((fallthrough)); for GCC 13.

vendor/CMSIS_std/Device/ST/STM32F30x/ (device headers V1.2.2)
  Source:  same STSW-STM32108 package
  License: ST's Additional License Terms list "STM32F30x CMSIS" as
           BSD-3-Clause (text in vendor/CMSIS_std/LICENSE.txt). The two file
           headers name "MCD-ST Liberty SW License Agreement V2".

Not established by the ST documents: which of these terms ST applied to the
2015 versions (V1.2.2 and V1.2.3) kept here. The ST documents are the
Additional License Terms for the STM32F30x/31x library (2021) and SLA0048
Rev 6 (February 2026).
